high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "french_muses." The post features a woman standing outdoors in front of a grand, ornate building that resembles a château or palace. The architecture includes multiple windows with intricate detailing and a symmetrical design. The woman is dressed in a vibrant floral dress with red flowers on a green background. She is wearing red high-heeled sandals and holding a woven straw bag with a handle. In her other hand, she is holding a bouquet of pink tulips.
